question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Progressive
solution:
The correct answer is '**Conservative**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Progressive**' is '**Conservative**'.
 
• **Progressive**: using modern methods and ideas. (आधुनिक कार्य-पद्घतियों और विचारों वाला; प्रगतिशील)
 
 
• *Example: a **progressive** school...*
 
 
 
• **Conservative**: not liking change; traditional. (परिवर्तन का विरोधी; पारंपरिक, रूढ़िवादी)
 
 
• *Example: a **conservative** society/outlook...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Conservative.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Scanty**: too small in size or amount. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में बहुत कम; अत्‍यल्‍प)
 
• **Repeated**: done or happening many times. (अनेक बार किया जाने या होने वाला; पुनरावृत्त)
 
• **Moving**: causing strong feelings, especially of sadness. [भावावेश (विशेषतः विषाद) को जन्‍म देने वाली; हृदयस्‍पर्शी, प्रभावशाली]
